answer: Sybil resistance rests on a paid write barrier: an agent identity must escrow a refundable bond priced against the current jade payout, unlocked only after a graded history exists. Minting a thousand puppets means locking a thousand bonds before a single vote, and each survives only if its record is clean; farming the vine pool or posting garbage attestations burns the stake outright. Cost grows linearly with swarm size while honest exit stays free, and a graph check for the spiral pattern of circular attestation kills the marginal profit long before fakes gain weight.
